3 products in 1 pack
GNC AMP Strength Vitapak Program delivers the power of three science-based formulas to help you achieve your daily nutritional goals as you build muscles and get stronger.
Increase strength & fuel your muscles 189% more efficiently
Because Creatine HCI 189 is clinically shown to be absorbed into your muscles 189% more efficiently than creatine monohydrate, you can increase strength & performance with 1/4 of the dose.
When used in conjunction with regular resistance training
If it's on our packages, then it's in our boxes. Clinically studied ingredients backed by real science. Get vitamins. Fuel muscles. Get stronger.

Move 9.5x more weight
In a randomized, double-blind, clinical study of 57 healthy, young adult males, subjects who took GNC AMP Creatine HCI 189 containing only 1.25 grams of the PEG-Creatine System significantly improved leg press 1-RM performance by 54.3 pounds, while subjects receiving 5 grams of creatine monohydrate significantly improved performance by 52.3 pounds and the placebo group showed no significant improvement at 5.7 pounds at the end of the study.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Vitapak program for performance + muscle support
Increases strength & fuels your muscles 189% more efficiently
In a clinical study of 17 healthy young adults, muscle biopsy results revealed that GNC AMP Creatine HCI 189 resulted in 189% greater muscle creatine uptake relative to benchmark amounts of ordinary creatine monohydrate powder.
